notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing the demo. I truly appreciate the valuable feedback from you all. I'm excited to share the new demo update with many improvements based on feedback.
Here is the changelog: 

 New planets
 New tutorial
 The title screen! 
 Multiple orbs instead of single orb 
 UI tweaks
 Sound tweaks

Stay tuned for the upcoming improvements!
